name: escapement
description: Escapement converts available agent capacity plus delegated authority into verified, delivered outcomes while reserving human attention for consequential choices.

interface.shortDescription: A client-neutral control layer for directing agent capacity within delegated authority, verifying outcomes independently, and completing authorized delivery.
interface.longDescription: Escapement converts available agent capacity plus delegated authority into verified, delivered outcomes while reserving human attention for consequential choices. Oracle-discipline gates block implementation-echo tests and oracle downgrades. TDD enforcement requires a Test Oracle Brief before writing code. Beads provides durable issue tracking. Works alongside your existing workflow.
